# JSDoc Expert Agent

This project is a specification-first system for mastering and enforcing JSDoc standards.

## Project Structure
- /content: Atomic Markdown pillars (The Specs).
- /agent/rules/docs-completeness.md: Canonical completeness requirements.
- /agent/skills/spec-compliance-skill.md: Audit workflow and report format.
- /mcp/server.js: MCP server entrypoint (stdio transport).
- /mcp/audit/: Deterministic AST parsing and completeness scoring.

## Core Pillars
1. Tags: Documentation of all JSDoc tags.
2. Types: Type definition standards.
3. Modules: Module and export conventions.
4. Generics: Template usage standards.

## Agent Instructions
When assisting with JSDoc, prioritize the content found in /content, validate against /agent/rules/docs-completeness.md, and follow the workflow in /agent/skills/spec-compliance-skill.md.
